description_en: Queries the log backup files of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS SQL Server实例的日志备份文件
name: DescribeLogBackupFiles

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30 to 1000. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30~1000。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

DownloadLink.description_en: The HTTP-based download URL of the log file. If the log file cannot be downloaded, an empty string is returned
DownloadLink.description_zh: HTTP协议的下载链接。若当前不可下载，则为空串

FileSize.description_en: The size of the log file. Unit: bytes

IntranetDownloadLink.description_en: The URL that is used to download the log file over an internal network. If the log file cannot be downloaded, an empty string is returned. This URL is valid for one hour
IntranetDownloadLink.description_zh: 内网下载地址，若当前不可下载，则为空串。有效期1小时

LinkExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the URL. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

LogBeginTime.description_en: The start time of the log file. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LogBeginTime.description_zh: 日志文件记录的开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

LogEndTime.description_en: The end time of the log file. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LogEndTime.description_zh: 日志文件记录的结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the page returned

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of log files on the current page

TotalFileSize.description_en: The total size of log files. Unit: bytes
TotalFileSize.description_zh: 所有日志文件大小之和，单位：Byte

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of log files
